contentPattern.structure: dynamic list of magazine articles (image + title + description) from query index

suitableFor: any auto-populated list of magazine articles from the query index
notSuitableFor: static hand-authored card grids (use cards / cards-adventure)

notes: Bespoke custom dynamic block (capstone requirement). Not derived from a vanilla Block Collection block; fetches entries from query-index.json filtered by magazine path prefix. Renders card-style teasers. Author configures source path prefix, index URL, and limit via block config rows.
